WITH wave AS (
    SELECT c.card_id, c.issued, d.client_id, d.account_id,
           p.birth_date, p.district_id AS client_district_id,
           a.district_id AS account_district_id, district.district_id
    FROM main.card AS c
    LEFT JOIN main.disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    LEFT JOIN main.client AS p ON p.client_id = d.client_id
    LEFT JOIN main.account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    LEFT JOIN main.district AS district ON district.district_id = p.district_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', c.issued) = '1994' OR c.issued LIKE '1994%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS issued_cards,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wave.card_id) AS distinct_cards,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wave.client_id) AS distinct_clients,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wave.district_id) AS distinct_client_districts,
       MIN(wave.issued) AS first_issue,
       MAX(wave.issued) AS last_issue,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', wave.issued) IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS invalid_issue_dates,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', wave.birth_date) IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_birth_years,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN wave.district_id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_client_districts,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN wave.client_district_id <> wave.account_district_id THEN 1 END) AS differing_districts
FROM wave

WITH cardholders AS (
    SELECT
        cl.client_id,
        cl.gender,
        cl.birth_date,
        c.type AS card_type,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', c.issued) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_card_issue,
        dp.account_id,
        cl.district_id
    FROM main.card AS c
    JOIN main.disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN main.client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE c.issued >= '1994-01-01' AND c.issued < '1995-01-01'
),
account_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM main.loan AS l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
)
SELECT
    ch.client_id,
    ch.gender,
    ch.birth_date,
    ch.card_type,
    ch.age_at_card_issue,
    COALESCE(al.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(al.total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN al.number_of_loans > 0 AND ch.age_at_card_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        WHEN al.number_of_loans > 0 AND ch.age_at_card_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
        ELSE 'Non-borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    dt.A2 AS district_name,
    dt.A11 AS district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ch.gender
        ORDER BY ch.age_at_card_issue DESC
    ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM cardholders AS ch
LEFT JOIN account_loans AS al ON al.account_id = ch.account_id
LEFT JOIN main.district AS dt ON dt.district_id = ch.district_id
ORDER BY ch.client_id
